full_prompt_en: A square storybook painting shows a dense cluster of gray stone castle towers beside still water under a muted, warm gray sky. The buildings fill almost the entire upper half of the frame, their steep roofs, narrow turrets and layered chimneys rising at varied heights. Farther towers fade into a misty, pale background, while the front walls remain sharply enough drawn to show individual blocks and narrow openings. A few small windows hold warm amber light; near the left edge, one pointed opening glows especially brightly. At the base of the castle, a curved narrow walkway crosses the dark water from left to right. Two tiny dark human silhouettes stand close together on the path near the center, facing the monumental architecture. Their thin reflections stretch downward, joining the warm window lights mirrored on the nearly black blue-gray surface. Across the lower portion, the water is smooth except for soft vertical smears of color, and a muted green strip borders the very bottom edge. The forms have a matte, finely grainy painted surface, with softly irregular outlines rather than slick architectural precision. The strongest contrast lies where small orange lights interrupt the cool gray walls. Diffuse light from above keeps the sky luminous and the towers gently shaded, while the lit openings make intimate points of warmth. The overall composition balances towering clustered geometry against an open, reflective foreground, creating a hushed and gently mysterious atmosphere.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形故事书绘画描绘静水旁密集的灰石城堡塔楼，天空是低饱和的暖灰色。建筑几乎填满画面上半部，陡屋顶、狭窄角塔和层叠烟囱高低错落。更远的塔楼淡入朦胧浅色背景，前方墙体则足够清楚，可见石块与细窄开口。几扇小窗发出暖琥珀光；靠左侧的一处尖顶入口尤其明亮。城堡脚下，一条狭窄弧形步道从左向右跨过深水。两个小小的深色人影相邻站在中央附近的路上，面向巨大的建筑。他们细长的倒影向下延伸，与几处暖窗光一起映在近乎黑色的蓝灰水面。下方水面除柔软的竖向色痕外十分平静，最底边有一道低饱和绿色。形体呈哑光而细颗粒的绘画表面，轮廓略不规则，并非光滑精确的建筑制图。最强对比出现在小片橙光打破冷灰墙体之处。上方漫射光令天空发亮、塔楼轻轻受阴影，亮窗则成为亲密的暖点。整体构图以高耸密集的几何形体平衡开敞的倒影前景，气氛安静而略带神秘。
style_prompt_en: A matte storybook painting combines softly simplified geometry with fine granular texture. Cool stone grays, slate blues and dusty taupes dominate large areas, while sparse amber accents punctuate the subdued field. Silhouettes remain recognizable through layered shapes rather than hard technical outlines; nearer edges have more definition and distant forms dissolve into pale haze. Small luminous points carry unusual weight against broad shadow masses. Reflections extend the vertical rhythm into a quiet lower field, softening crisp structural shapes into blurred color. Diffused ambient light controls the scene, with localized warm glow deepening the surrounding cool tones. Dense upper detail and a broad calm foreground create a measured, contemplative spacing. The visual effect is restrained, atmospheric and gently uncanny.
style_prompt_zh: 这种哑光故事书绘画结合柔化的简化几何与细颗粒肌理。冷石灰、板岩蓝和灰褐色占据大面积，零星琥珀亮色点入低饱和画面。轮廓借层叠形体保持可辨，而非靠坚硬的技术线；近处边缘较清楚，远形消融进浅雾。细小发光点在宽阔暗块前具有格外强的分量。倒影把竖向节奏延入平静下部，将较清晰的结构化成模糊色彩。漫射环境光统领画面，局部暖辉又加深周围冷调。上方密集细节与宽阔宁静的前景形成有分寸的疏密。视觉效果克制、富于空气感且微带奇异。
theme_en: A gray stone castle and two small figures beside still reflective water
theme_zh: 静水旁的灰色石堡与两个小小人影
name: Alan Parry
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
